watches.name: Sapphire Crystal for Omega 600m "PloProf"
watches.description: This is a sapphire replacement crystal for the Omega 600m "PloProf", custom made to be an exact replacement for the mineral glass crystal supplied with the watch. It uses AR coating on the inside. Crystal replacement should be done by a professional watchmaker. Each crystal is carefully inspected for scratches and defects. Exchanges are not available and returns are not accepted regardless of claim. OCEAN7 Watch Company is not associated in any way with Omega S.A. This crystal does not fit the LM-7.

watches.name: Yantar Crown and Tube
watches.description: The crown and tube assembly used on the original Yantar watches has been troublesome. Sooner or later all will require replacement. Our crown and tube assembly is custom made to retrofit the Yantar case. It uses a different design that elminates the problem that causes the original assembly to fail. Note: These parts must be installed by a professional watchmaker. They are damaged easily if installed incorrectly. They cannot be installed at home. We will not accept returns or claims for defective parts on this item.

watches.name: LM-4 V2 Meteor Ceramic
watches.description: The OCEAN7 Meteor Ceramic case is unique. It is individually fitted with a steel inner case that houses the movement and anchors the case back. It also features a domed sapphire crystal that is pressed (Not glued) into the case. Unlike similar ceramic cases, our case hides the inner steel case under the bezel resulting in a sleek, clean look. Case: Three piece matte finished ceramic with PVD stainless steel case back Dimensions: Width 44mm. Lug to Lug 55mm.
